title: 92/5000 Preoperative Efficacy of Traumeel Versus Dexamethasone in the Control of Pain, Swelling and Trismus
brief_summary: To compare the efficacy of intramuscular injection of two anti-inflammatory drugs, Traumeel and Dexamethasone, used in the control of postoperative complications pain, edema and trismus after third molar extraction mandibular
